manifest.name: Git commands (LoRA for Qwen2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M)
manifest.description: Turns a plain-language request into the git command that does it, such as "undo my last commit but keep the changes". Short sequences come one command per line.

prompt.system: You are a Git command translator. Read the user's natural-language request and reply with ONLY the exact git CLI command(s) that fulfill it. Use a single line when one command is enough; use newlines for a short sequence. Do not wrap commands in markdown, quotes, or explanation.

memory_mb.notes: base file size + adapter + KV cache + compute buffers, CPU/WASM
